description: Qorix traceability gate — on a change, compute its downstream impact across the artifact graph (intention→requirements→architecture→design→code→tests→docs) and verify trace integrity, driven by `qik axon`.

priming.description: Confirm the trace graph is whole before relying on it.

steps.label: Impact analysis
steps.description: Downstream effect cone of the changed need: a dependency list of artifacts to touch, each with its need id, direction/distance from the start, and source location (file, line from–to). Substitute <ID> with the changed need; use `qik axon blast` for structural changes that ripple upward too.

steps.label: Slice review
steps.prompt: For each artifact in the dependency list, read only its reported location range and judge whether it drifts from the change. Propose edits to the authored needs / code markers; never apply them silently. Answer per artifact with OK, or DRIFT plus location and the proposed change.
steps.description: Coordinates, not content: read ranges rather than whole files. The graph is changed by editing the sphinx-needs source and rebuilding, never by hand-editing needs.json.

steps.label: Trace integrity
steps.description: Orphans and dangling links. Any error-severity statement blocks: the graph is broken and must be repaired before the change is done.

output.note: `qik axon … --mcp` emits dependency lists (trace/impact/blast, each entry carrying direction/distance from the start) and the same Report JSON shape the qik-mcp server exposes via the axon_* tools.
